newsitem.title: ITALY: Alitalia sees no alliance news in August.
newsitem.headline: Alitalia sees no alliance news in August.

text.p: Alitalia does not expect to make any announcement about possible alliances with other airlines this month, a spokesman for the state carrier said on Tuesday.
Earlier in the day, stock in Alitalia was suspended limit up in Milan, continuing a recent rally on market hopes of a link with Dutch carrier KLM.
"I do not think that anything will be resolved in August. We'll talk about it again in September," the spokesman said, declining to comment on talk of any possible alliance with KLM.
KLM on Friday confirmed it was in talks with Alitalia on a possible alliance but played down reports they were at an advanced stage. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
